claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.free_hand
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item triggered-reaction family fits the damage-reduction mechanic, but the activation cannot currently express the explicit requirement that the wearer have a free hand when using the reaction.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 plus your Dexterity modifier if you have a free hand
